dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with jagged, scalloped perimeters. Edge gradients transition sharply from high-intensity white/light-gray (RGB approx. 210, 210, 210) to low-intensity dark charcoal (RGB approx. 40, 40, 40) across 3-5 pixel widths.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of interconnected, high-intensity pixel filaments forming a continuous reticulated network. Solid low-intensity blobs are nested within these filaments, primarily concentrated in the central and posterior-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest identifiable macro-annuli in the upper-right quadrant form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a secondary cluster in the mid-section forms a nearly linear horizontal alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct region of micro-reticulation in the lower-left field of view where the high-intensity network transforms into a dense, honeycomb-like lattice with significantly smaller cell diameters compared to the dorsal mid-section.
